title: Choosing the Right Speech Recognition Dataset for Your AI Model
summary: Imagine asking a voice assistant to summarize a long meeting, translate it into Spanish, and push the action items into your CRM—all from a single voice note. Behind that “magic” is not just a powerful model like Whisper or an LLM like Gemini or ChatGPT. It’s the speech recognition datasets used to train and fine-tune […]
